annotations.title: Ask for an edit to be changed

description: Re-edits a finished order with new instructions, for example "keep the story about the dog, it was cut" or "the intro music is too loud". It creates a new order from the original recording and returns its order_id. The progress and result of that order are reported by barevalue_status. It uses the same minutes from the allowance as the original order. Every revision is made from the original recording, so one request carries everything that is to be different. It returns the edited audio. The show notes and clips are made again only when the instructions ask for them.

api_key.description: Barevalue API key (bv_sk_...), as returned by barevalue_register. Not needed when the connection already sends an Authorization: Bearer header.

instructions.description: What to change, in plain language (10 to 2000 characters)

order_id.description: The finished order to change (the original, not an earlier revision)

name: barevalue_request_revision
title: Ask for an edit to be changed
